title: The pentagonal bipyramid as the unique logarithmic-energy minimiser for seven points on the sphere: an unreviewed Lean 4 warrant (Conjecture 1 of Armentano et al.)
description:
A Lean 4 formalisation states and checks that, among all configurations of seven distinct points on the unit sphere S^2, the regular pentagonal bipyramid uniquely minimises the logarithmic energy, up to orthogonal transformations and relabelling (Conjecture 1 of Armentano et al., J. Symbolic Comput. 137 (2026)); Comparator and the independent checker nanoda accept it. The same is stated and checked for the Riesz s = 2 energy. AI-produced, not peer reviewed.

A public, timestamped, AI-produced warrant: a machine-checked argument that no human has yet digested. We do not regard the question as settled by it; independent verification and human-readable expositions are welcome. The repository also contains the exact three-point certificates, as JSON, with independent exact checkers in Python.
notes: Not peer reviewed. Produced by AI models (Claude Opus 5.5; reviews by Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1 and gpt-6-astra) under the direction of the repository owner; see AI_DISCLOSURE.md. The supporting Lean library uses declarations of huwngtran/thomson-n7-lean (commit 25f2fa5); unchanged declarations are regenerated from that repository by lean/regen.sh and are not stored here.
